profile.headline: Software Engineer at Syngenta
profile.summary:
Throughout my young career I used my self-motivating, hard-working, and not afraid to get my hands dirty skill sets to be successful, however, it was not until recently, when I had my child, that I felt just working hard was not enough. My child gave me the extra motivation to go back to school and get a degree, so I can show him that there are other opportunities out there through education.

 I have always enjoyed learning and  being in school, but I was never too sure on what path I wanted to take in my education. The past few years I have really enjoyed technology, and have grown a passion for Android or anything Google. That passion of technology is what propelled me to want to study Computer Information. The small projects that I have completed, like developing a relational database and create console programs, fueled my eagerness to join the IT world.

With the opportunities that I have received by Union Pacific Railroad, I have been successful and accomplished a lot personally and throughout my career. My job has given me the chance to get married, buy a house, and start a family. As well as building communication, leadership, and team working skills. I am looking forward to applying the hard-working and team leading skill sets that I have honed by holding the position of leadman, in Union Pacific Railroad, to the IT world. I have truly enjoyed learning and gaining experience of many of the different aspects of the vast IT department, and I am very excited to start this new career path.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Re-architected a production OpenSearch deployment on AWS, replacing an index-per-user design that had grown to thousands of indexes with a scalable UUID-based indexing and rollover strategy.

• Architected a Python-based, event-driven geospatial processing platform on AWS for agricultural machine data including planting, harvesting, and spraying. Built workflows with Step Functions, DynamoDB, Kinesis, S3, PyArrow, and GeoPandas, scaling the platform from hundreds of U.S. users to thousands globally.

• Designed an AI-assisted modernization workflow using Claude to migrate mature Java 8 microservices into a TypeScript/NestJS platform backed by PostgreSQL and Redis while maintaining business-rule and API-contract parity.

• Built specialized AI agents for specification generation, implementation, code review, behavioral parity, and QA test generation using project-specific guardrails and MCP tooling. The workflow reduced complex endpoint migrations to approximately 3 days including QA, with engineers providing steering, review, and final validation.

• Owned features end-to-end from requirements and technical design through implementation, QA, stakeholder review, and production delivery.

• Planned technical epics and stories, estimated work, presented solutions to business and technical stakeholders, and collaborated with globally distributed engineering teams.
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Agentic Automation and +4 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed an MVP product for Smart Order Router, Settlement Engine, and Rate
Engine, using Spring 5 Webflux and Reactive streams.

- Built an AML/Compliance tool that allowed our compliance team to quickly search for
any violations.

- Built a customer facing OTC portal that allowed for easy onboarding and trading crypto
assets for our preferred customer line, which has helped increase the volume trade by
300%.
- Implemented 3rd party KYC/AML identity block score for certain customer needs.

- Provisioned an AWS infrastructure using Terraform. Our infrastructure included
VPN, Bastion Host, RDS, EKS, and Application Load Balance with HELM.
